about_the_game:
WHIMSIDE is a cozy and relaxing collection game that sits at the bottom of your screen, keeping you company whether you're working, studying, or just kicking back and watching videos. Embark on a journey through enchanting worlds, each filled with unique creatures and hidden secrets. Capture and create new species of Whimlings, then unleash your creativity by decorating your very whimsical space.

Play at your own pace, in a relaxing adventure that’s always ready to offer a refuge throughout the day!

EXPLORE THE WORLD OF WHIMSIDE

Set off to explore the world of WHIMSIDE. Capture or hybridize Whimlings to unlock new biomes. TEach biome is rich with secrets and surprises, not to mention rare new species to uncover and collect!

DESIGN YOUR OWN WHIMSICAL SPACE

As you progress, you’ll unlock a variety of decorations, empowering you to personalize your own whimsical haven - from a peaceful garden to an extravagant outdoor playground! Your favorite Whimlings can also settle in, keeping you company throughout the day.

CREATE YOUR PERFECT WHIMLING

Fuse two Whimlings into a whole new creature!. Every unique combination reveals a procedurally generated new species, which will help you unlock new biomes and decorations!

UNLEASH THE TWITCH MAGIC

Our special Twitch integration is designed specifically for streamers, allowing you to share your adventure with your community. Interactions happen seamlessly, with no need for commands, providing a smooth and non-intrusive experience. The more your viewers engage, the more in-game rewards you’ll earn.

  • WHIMSIDE is perfect to stream alongside Just Chatting, Art, or any other content.

  • Let your viewers help you spot the rarest Whimlings while you focus on something else.

  • Unlock bonuses thanks to viewer participation.

  • Automatically assign names to Whimlings based on your most active viewers.

  • Celebrate hype trains with special in-game events.

WISHLIST AND JOIN THE ADVENTURE

Hi, we’re Toadzillart and Tadpoly, the game dev couple behind WHIMSIDE. Creating this enchanting universe has been a true labor of love for us. If WHIMSIDE inspires you, please consider adding it to your wishlist. It’s the best way to support us on this creative journey. Thank you for being part of this adventure and helping to bring this whimsical world to life!

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3 @ 3.2 GHZ
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with DX9
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 256 MB available space

short_description: A creature collection game that sits at the bottom of your screen & fits easily into your routine. Whether you're working, studying, or relaxing, Whimside is always ready to offer you cozy pauses. Capture rare creatures, create new species & decorate your whimsical space in this soothing adventure.
supported_languages: English, French, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian
